scope: 50 US states targeted; electronic transactions and trade secrets only; DC and territories excluded.

status_meaning.SOURCE-ESTABLISHED: Official substantive source opened; supports only the cited text, not applicability or complete legal protection.
status_meaning.UNVERIFIED: Official substantive text not confirmed in this bounded pass; citation is a lead only, not an established legal conclusion.

limitations: Legal information, not legal advice or automatic nationwide protection.
State and federal rules interact; jurisdiction, scope, consent, exceptions and facts require separate review.
Public Apache-licensed repository contents are not made trade secrets by this catalog.
No license amendment, NDA, copyright registration, patent filing, legal notice service or infringement finding.
No comprehensive case-law, common-law, remedy, limitations-period or post-observation amendment review.
Page access and tests do not prove statutory correctness, legal applicability or validity of any project signature.
Edition labels and inaccessible pages remain source limits; successful HTTP responses without statute text do not count as opened.
Recorded HTTP URLs are retained as observed rather than silently rewritten to HTTPS; transport and source authenticity were not independently certified.
Some opened provisions establish only statutory titles, definitions or scope; each row states what was and was not read.
